claims.claim_text: Approximately 90% of HII's 2021 revenues were generated from the U.S. Navy.
claims.subject: Huntington Ingalls Industries
claims.source_quote: In 2021, 2020, and 2019, approximately 90%, 88%, and 87%, respectively, of our revenues were generated from the U.S. Navy.

claims.claim_text: Aircraft carrier programs (CVN 78 Ford-class incl. CVN 79 Kennedy, CVN 80 Enterprise, CVN 81 Doris Miller; CVN 73/74 RCOH) accounted for ~32% of FY2021 consolidated revenue; HII expects Ford-class build-out and follow-on RCOH awards through the next decade.
claims.subject: Newport News Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: CVN-78 Ford class aircraft carriers ~32% of consolidated revenue FY2021; forward pipeline = CVN 80, CVN 81 build + CVN 73/74 RCOH
claims.source_quote: For the year ended December 31, 2021, our aircraft carrier programs accounted for approximately 32% of our consolidated revenue... we have received awards valued at $15.3 billion for detail design and construction of the Gerald R. Ford class (CVN 78) aircraft carriers Enterprise (CVN 80) and Doris Miller (CVN 81)... We are currently performing the RCOH of USS George Washington (CVN 73) and USS John C. Stennis (CVN 74).

claims.claim_text: HII is in production on Virginia-class (SSN 774) Block IV and Block V submarines under a teaming agreement with General Dynamics Electric Boat; FY2022 NDAA recommends continued procurement of two Virginia-class boats per FY.
claims.subject: Newport News Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: Virginia class SSN 774 Block IV (10 boats) + Block V (10 boats, 2/yr); FY2022 NDAA supports 2/FY procurement
claims.source_quote: In 2019, the team was awarded a construction contract for the fifth block of nine Virginia class (SSN 774) submarines, and, in 2021, an option for a 10th submarine was exercised... the fiscal year 2022 National Defense Authorization Act recommends continued procurement of two Virginia class (SSN 774) submarines per fiscal year.

claims.claim_text: Newport News is participating in design and construction of the Columbia-class (SSBN 826) submarine as a subcontractor to Electric Boat; first two boats contract awarded late 2020, program of 12 boats.
claims.subject: Newport News Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: Columbia SSBN 826 — module-build subcontractor to GD/EB, 12-boat program of record
claims.source_quote: The Columbia class (SSBN 826) program currently anticipates 12 new ballistic missile submarines... Contract award for the first two Columbia class submarines (SSBN 826 and SSBN 827) and construction start of the first Columbia class (SSBN 826) submarine occurred in late 2020.

claims.claim_text: HII is the sole builder of LHA amphibious assault ships (LHA 8 Bougainville under construction; LHA 9 long-lead awarded 2020) and an active producer of LPD-class amphibious transport docks (LPD 28-31).
claims.subject: Ingalls Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: LHA Flight II (LHA 8, LHA 9) + LPD Flight II (LPD 28-31)
claims.source_quote: We delivered USS Tripoli (LHA 7) in 2020 and are currently constructing Bougainville (LHA 8). In 2020, we were awarded a long-lead-time material and construction contract for LHA 9 (unnamed)... In 2020, we were awarded a contract to construct Pittsburgh (LPD 31).

kwargs.program_name: LPD-17 Flight II San Antonio class

claims.claim_text: HII is in a 2018 multi-year contract for six additional Arleigh Burke (DDG 51) destroyers ($5.1B); FY2022 NDAA broadly supports increased funding authority for DDG-51.
claims.subject: Ingalls Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: DDG 51 Arleigh Burke — 2018 multi-year $5.1B for six boats, plus 2020 add-on
claims.source_quote: In 2018, we were awarded a multi-year contract totaling $5.1 billion for construction of six additional Arleigh Burke class (DDG 51) destroyers... The National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2022 was enacted in December 2021 and broadly supports our shipbuilding programs, including increased funding authority for Arleigh Burke -class destroyers (DDG-51)

claims.claim_text: HII is the sole builder of large National Security Cutters (Legend class NSC) for the U.S. Coast Guard; NSC 10 (Calhoun) and NSC 11 (Friedman) under construction.
claims.subject: Ingalls Shipbuilding
claims.object_value: Legend class NSC — sole source, NSC 10 + NSC 11 under construction
claims.source_quote: We are the sole builder of large multi-mission NSCs for the U.S. Coast Guard... In 2018, we were awarded long-lead-time material and construction contracts for Calhoun (NSC 10) and Friedman (NSC 11), which are currently under construction.

claims.claim_text: Total backlog of $48.5B as of Dec 31, 2021 ($22.7B funded); HII expects ~19% of backlog to convert to sales in 2022.
claims.subject: HII consolidated
claims.object_value: $48.5B total backlog; $22.7B funded; ~19% conversion to FY2022 sales
claims.source_quote: As of December 31, 2021 and 2020, our total backlog was approximately $48.5 billion and $46.0 billion, respectively. We expect approximately 19% of backlog at December 31, 2021, to be converted into sales in 2022.

claims.claim_text: Technical Solutions segment unified via 2021 acquisition of Alion Science and Technology, providing high-end IT/mission-based solutions for DoD, intelligence and federal civilian customers.
claims.subject: Technical Solutions
claims.object_value: Alion Science & Technology acquired Aug 2021 — basis for Technical Solutions roll-up
claims.source_quote: This segment was established to unify multiple strategic acquisitions, including the acquisition of Alion Science and Technology in August 2021.

claims.claim_text: HII holds a 51% interest in N3B (Los Alamos Legacy Cleanup), 23% in MSTS (Nevada National Security Site), 34% in SRNS (Savannah River Site) — DoE site management & operations JVs.
claims.subject: Technical Solutions — nuclear/environmental services
claims.source_quote: We have a 51% ownership interest in N3B, which, in 2017, was awarded the Los Alamos Legacy Cleanup Contract... 23% ownership interest in MSTS... 34% ownership interest in SRNS
